added.summary: Backgrounds, masks and border images select image-set candidates by viewport density, preserve density-correct intrinsic sizing, filter unsupported types before duplicate resolutions, and discover bare-string asset URLs. Retained documents and button part backgrounds reselect when DPR changes; saved drawings preserve image density.

fixed.summary: Preserve percentage slice and automatic-width metadata through the renderer instead of clamping it away; automatic widths account for image-set density.
